votes.motion: A motion was made by Brooke Christensen, seconded by Zach Robinson to approve the Consent Calendar, Item 2 as amended, Items 3 - 6, and the additional Items 9 and 10

A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Zach Robinson, to adopt Ordinance #21-33, an ordinance revising Title 21 of the Sandy City Municipal Code Chapter 16, "Floodplain Overlay Zone" (as shown in Exhibit "A") to amend certain requirements related to Flood Plains; also providing a saving clause and effective date for the ordinance

A motion was made by Brooke Christensen, seconded by Monica Zoltanski, to adopt the Ordinance #21-36, an ordinance revising Title 21 of the Sandy City Municipal Code chapter 23, "General Commercial, Office, Industrial, and Transit Development Standards" to permit more flexibility with setback requirements in the Central Business District (CBD) Zone if certain criteria is met; also providing a saving clause and effective date for the ordinance
A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Brooke Christensen to convene a closed session and adjourn the City Council meeting following the closed session

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Marci Houseman to adopt Ordinance 21-35, an ordinance modifying the official street map of Sandy by vacating 4,977 square feet of street right-of-way for the dead-end portion of Aspen Ridge Road at approximately 12180 South; also establishing an effective date

A motion was made by Kris Nicholl, seconded by Brooke Christensen to adopt Ordinance 21-34, an ordinance modifying the official street map of Sandy by vacating 29,276 square feet of street right-of-way for a portion of Centennial Parkway between 10200 South and Mall Ring Road; also establishing an effective date
